architecture_fit.original_request: Stop repeated unchanged overdue, human-wait and unperformed-report inputs while retaining meaningful revisions and original evidence.
architecture_fit.parent_structure: Existing shared ledger observation, card-event staged outbox, due-timer receipts and dispatcher delivery receipts.
architecture_fit.acceptance_rationale: Extend the existing semantic event publisher to these reasons and retain the existing locks and recovery states. No additional queue, ACK mechanism or host configuration is introduced.

validation_scope: Model-free pending/consumed deadline/report matrix; changed facts and legacy migration; five interrupted publication boundaries; enabled/disabled timer order; existing closed-worker and local-before-network invariants. Production remains unchanged until separately accepted.
